in_sanskrit.name: चन्दनकुमार
in_sanskrit.meaning: चन्दन (Chandan) - Sandalwood, कुमार (Kumar) - Younger brother, Son
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Chandankumar is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘चन्दन’ (Chandan) and ‘कुमार’ (Kumar). Chandan means sandalwood, and Kumar means younger brother, son. Thus, the name Chandankumar can be interpreted as the younger brother or son who is as pure and fragrant as sandalwood.

in_hindi.name: चन्दनकुमार
in_hindi.meaning: चन्दन (Chandan) - चंदना (Chandana) - Sandalwood, कुमार (Kumar) - कुमारा (Kumari) - Brother, Son
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Chandankumar in Hindi is composed of the words ‘चन्दन’ (Chandan), which means sandalwood, and ‘कुमार’ (Kumar), which means brother or son. Chandana, a derivative of Chandan, means sandalwood. Thus, the name Chandankumar can be interpreted as the younger brother or son who is as pure and fragrant as sandalwood.

in_marathi.name: Chandankumar

in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandankumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chandan (moon) + Kumar (younger form of Lord Kartikeya, god of war and son of Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati).
